subject.title: Surface Codex final answer candidates in activity

question: Should final-answer candidate lifecycle entries land now as a narrow Control UI Activity feature, or should they be folded into the broader native Codex progress UX tracked by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/80039?
rationale: The implementation idea is plausible and proven, but current main has moved the UI architecture and the remaining choice is product/UX scope rather than a mechanical patch defect.

options.title: Port and land the narrow slice
options.body: Rebase the branch onto the current Activity/chat stream files and land answer-candidate entries while keeping the broader issue open for plan/item/progress work.

options.title: Fold into broader progress work
options.body: Pause or close this PR after preserving its proof and implementation notes in the broader native Codex Control UI progress issue.

recommendation.title: Port and land the narrow slice
recommendation.body: Rebase the branch onto the current Activity/chat stream files and land answer-candidate entries while keeping the broader issue open for plan/item/progress work.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history shows repeated work across the Codex projector and Activity safety surfaces affected by this product-scope decision.
